jobs.title: Leader, Salesforce Digital – Canada
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology company that leads with outcomes and teams with leaders, bringing more together. Our purpose is to help people and organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows for all. Every day we bring our heads and our hearts to being a trusted copilot, respectful challenger, and unwavering champion for each of our customers.
Our strategic vision is to be the first in our industry to lead with bringing more and delivering outcomes as we work to become the world’s most customer-obsessed and employee-empowered services company. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Job Title:
  Senior Principal, Salesforce Digital – Canada 
(For Vacant Role)

What You’ll Do

As the Senior Principal, Salesforce Digital – Canada, you will serve as a market-facing leader representing Slalom’s Salesforce Digital capabilities across the Canadian market. Based in Toronto, you will bring deep expertise in marketing technology and customer engagement while representing the broader Salesforce Digital portfolio across Marketing, Commerce, Loyalty, Experience, and Contentful. You will partner closely with Canadian market and account leaders, Salesforce, clients, and Slalom’s broader Salesforce Digital leadership to identify opportunities, shape solutions, and drive growth. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between customer and marketing strategy, technical solutioning, delivery, and consultative selling—connecting business needs to executable technology solutions.

Go-to-Market & Business Development

Represent Salesforce Digital in the Canadian market, connecting clients and account teams to Slalom’s broader Digital capabilities and expertise.
Be accountable for driving Salesforce Digital sales, pipeline, and revenue growth across Canada.
Partner with Canadian market and account leaders to identify, shape, and advance Salesforce Digital and MarTech opportunities.
Build strong relationships with Salesforce leaders and sellers to develop joint opportunities and go-to-market motions.
Lead strategic pursuits from discovery through solutioning, proposals, executive presentations, and close.
Lead executive conversations and workshops that connect customer strategy, business value, and technology.

MarTech & Solution Leadership

Serve as a senior MarTech and Salesforce Digital SME for strategic Canadian opportunities and clients.
Help clients define customer engagement and MarTech strategies grounded in their business and customer needs.
Shape solutions spanning marketing, commerce, loyalty, experience, content, data, and AI.
Guide platform, architecture, integration, and solution decisions across Salesforce Digital and the broader MarTech ecosystem.
Partner with architects and technical teams to ensure solutions are credible, scalable, and aligned to intended business outcomes.

Capability Development

Strengthen Salesforce Digital expertise and delivery capacity within Canada in partnership with broader Salesforce Digital leadership.
Mentor and develop consultants across Salesforce Digital and MarTech.
Connect Canadian teams to broader Salesforce Digital expertise, offerings, accelerators, and communities.
Contribute thought leadership, reusable solutions, and best practices that strengthen Slalom’s Salesforce Digital capability.
Delivery Management
Contribute in billable strategic, advisory, solution architecture, delivery leadership, or technical leadership roles on key Canadian accounts, with a 65% target utilization.
Provide senior oversight from pursuit through delivery, maintaining continuity between the client vision and delivered solution.
Partner with delivery teams to ensure solution quality, effective execution, and successful client outcomes.

What You’ll Bring

10+ years of experience in consulting, MarTech, digital transformation, customer experience, Salesforce, or related technology disciplines.
Consulting or professional services experience with demonstrated success in senior client-facing roles.
Deep understanding of marketing technology and modern customer engagement, extending beyond a single platform or product.
Strong Salesforce Digital experience across Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Loyalty Management, and Experience Cloud, with experience in Contentful or modern content platforms highly valued.
Understanding of how Salesforce Digital connects with CRM, Data Cloud, AI, identity, integration, analytics, and the broader MarTech ecosystem.
Ability to translate business and customer objectives into technology strategies, solution architectures, and actionable roadmaps.
Strong experience in technical pre-sales, solution consulting, and complex pursuits from discovery through close.
Experience serving as a solution lead, delivery lead, or senior SME on complex, multi-capability engagements.
Executive presence and the ability to engage cross-functionally with CIOs, CMOs, CTOs, and other senior client executives on business and technology strategy.
Experience with Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies, including program management and the software delivery lifecycle.
Strong storytelling, facilitation, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor complex concepts and materials to both business and technical audiences.
Active Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification(s) required. Additional Salesforce certifications are preferred, with the ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.
Ability to travel as needed.

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Hybrid/In office:
 We are hybrid but there are expectations that if your team leader or client requires you onsite that you are able to meet those expectations/requirements.

Slalom Employee Perks:

Culture & fun!
Lunch & learns
Health & wellness activities
Holiday parties
Employee community groups
Social clubs & activities
Vacation (20 days prorated based on start date & wellness/sick days)

Tangible perks

Competitive compensation package
$100 cell phone monthly reimbursement
Registered Retirement Program (RRSP) & Employer Matching
Tax-Free Savings Account (TFSA)
Annual “Thrive Well-Being” Gift Card
Family planning/ Fertility Benefit
Maternity/Parental Leave Top-Up
Medical & Dental Benefits
Life and AD&D Insurance
Access to Supplementary Life and AD&D Insurance
Access to the Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Inkblot Therapy
And more!

*All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements

Slalom is an inclusive, equal opportunity employer dedicated to building a diverse workforce. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will work to reasonably accommodate applicants’ needs throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. Please advise the talent acquisition team if you require accommodations during the interview process.

Please note if you are hired at Slalom you will be required to complete a background check.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. jobs.title: Director, Web Services
jobs.description:
Simons was founded in 1840 by John Simons in Quebec City. Originally a dry goods store, the family company is known today for accessible and inspired fashion. It is committed to cultivating creativity and building meaningful relationships with its staff, partners, and clientele. The company cares about the environment and about the communities in which it does business.

Simons is recognized as a fashion authority with an original shopping concept. Exclusive collections, emerging local and nationally recognized brands, and pieces by top designer names are all available under one roof in the store’s distinctive zones.

Join The Simons Team as a Director of Web Services

Are you an analytical leader who sees opportunities to make complex operations work better? We’re looking for a Director of Web Services
to guide the evolution of the operation that supports our online business. You’ll set direction for order fulfillment, inventory movement, shipping and receiving, and returns. Working through the Web Services Manager and the broader team, you’ll assess performance, uncover the causes of challenges, and shape improvements that strengthen productivity, accuracy, and the customer experience. This role calls for a strategic thinker who can connect operational data to practical decisions, build accountability, and help a team grow.

What You'll Do

As Director of Web Services
, you will lead the overall performance and ongoing development of the operation supporting our online business. Working through the Web Services Manager and broader team, you will set priorities, assess results, and guide improvements across fulfillment, inventory movement, shipping and receiving, and returns. You will connect operational data to decisions that strengthen performance, build accountability, and help the operation evolve with the business and customer needs.

Set the Direction for Performance Excellence: Establish priorities and goals, review measures such as order accuracy, fulfillment times, productivity, and shipping performance, and use trends to guide decisions and resource planning.
Advance and Optimize Warehouse Operations: Assess how orders and products move through the operation, identify bottlenecks and root causes, and lead improvements to workflows and processes. Partner with the Web Services Manager to turn analysis into practical changes that improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary handling, and support reliable service.
Develop Leadership and Accountability: Lead and develop the Web Services Manager, who directs the team’s daily work. Set clear expectations, strengthen decision-making and accountability, and support employee development. Ensure the team has the training, tools, and resources to meet standards for safety, organization, inventory handling, and customer service.
Connect Operational Strategy to the Customer Experience: Ensure the operation supports accurate, timely online orders and effective returns processing. Work across the business to address broader challenges and help Web Services adapt as customer needs and the business evolve.

What We're Looking For

Leadership in Order Fulfillment and People Development: You have experience leading warehouse, logistics, distribution, e-commerce fulfillment, or a similar operation, and understand how receiving, stocking, picking, packing, shipping, and returns fit together. You’re skilled at developing leaders and teams, setting clear direction, building accountability, and helping others make sound decisions while balancing productivity, accuracy, service, and employee engagement.
Strong Analytical Judgment: You enjoy working with operational data, asking what is driving the results, and tracing issues to their root causes. You can translate complex findings into clear priorities, practical solutions, and measurable improvements.
A Process- Driven and Improvement Mindset: You look beyond individual tasks to understand how the operation functions as a whole. You can evaluate trade-offs, allocate resources, and guide improvements that strengthen performance over time.

Why You’ll Love It Here

Be Part of Something Special: Contribute to a historical Canadian brand and help shape a culture that values teamwork, creativity, and customer service.
Grow With Us: Enjoy opportunities to learn, lead, and grow your retail career in a rewarding and collaborative environment.
A Fun, Engaging Workplace: Join a team that believes in celebrating achievements and creating an enjoyable atmosphere where everyone feels valued.

If you’re ready to make a difference and eager to contribute to our legacy of excellence, we encourage you to apply today!

At Simons, people are at the heart of all that we do. We pay special attention to the well-being of our employees and their families, highlighting important moments that mark their journey, including service anniversaries and significant life milestones.

Creativity, community, and respect are an integral part of our DNA. We offer everyone the opportunity to build a career that’s suited to them, whether that’s at our stores, head office, or Campus in Quebec City. Proud to recognize our teams’ contributions, we provide competitive work conditions as well as a comprehensive and scalable range of benefits. We also promote flexibility and a welcoming, inclusive, and caring work environment, where everybody can reach their full potential.

Take this opportunity to join our dedicated team and make a difference at a company where people are the top priority.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. 

Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today!

See position seat

Our Commitment to Our People

Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial.

Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally.

Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. 

Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team!

Our Commitment to Inclusion & Belonging

At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce. Our employee resource groups play an important role in culture and community building at Copeland.

Copeland will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1 with OPT or CPT, H-1, H-2, L-1, B, J or TN, or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Copeland is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: copeland.careers@copeland.com

The Director / GM, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00

From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.
What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.

Hybrid/In office:
